title: Comments cause incorrect text shader line preview
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.8.dev custom build [95baa6f29], 4.7.stable.official. ### System information Godot v4.8.dev (95baa6f29) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6109) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1240P (16 threads) - 31.71 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description Shader line previews do not handle comments correctly. When an assignment has a trailing `//` comment, its preview may incorrectly include the following assignment and display that assignment's result instead. Comments containing braces or function-like code can also affect scope detection and brace counting, producing malformed preview shaders and compilation errors. Inline and multiline `/* ... */` comments can prevent otherwise valid assignments from being recognized. For example, in `simple_bug_test.gdshader`, previewing the statements at line 4/6/8 may display the result of the following blue assignment: or fail with: ```text SHADER ERROR: Expected constant, function, uniform or varying. ERROR: Shader compilation failed. ERROR: Parameter "version" is null. ``` Previewing an assignment with certain trailing comments may instead display: ```text Previewed line must contain an assignment. ``` ### Steps to reproduce 1. Open the attached project. 2. Open `simple_bug_test.gdshader` or `complex_bug_test.gdshader`. 3. Place the caret on one of the assignments containing a comment. 4. Press F9 to enable a shader line preview. 5. Observe that: - The preview may display the result of the following assignment. - An assignment may not be recognized. - Comments containing braces or function-like code may cause shader compilation errors. 6. Remove the comments and repeat the preview. 7. Observe that the preview works correctly. P.S. If the preview appears correct after opening or saving the file, place the caret on any line and press F9 twice. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [shader-preview-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29657669/shader-preview-bug.zip)
